name: init-check-verdict-signature
title: Bind the INIT-check verdict into its signature so tampered coverage fails closed
description: The INIT_CHECK gate decides on agentResults and issues inside init-check.json, but signInitCheck does not take either as input, so hand-editing agentResults leaves _hash still valid and the gate accepts the tampered file with zero subsequent calls. readInitCheck also performs no _hash verification before the handler carries previous.agentResults forward. Prove the end-to-end behaviour by execution first, then cover the verdict fields with the signature and verify before trusting on read, choosing and arguing a migration position for a corpus in which roughly 30 percent of files carry an actor that is no longer registry-valid.
